'''Termylle''' was the fourth Queen of [[Andor]], succeeding Queen [[Melasune]] in {{Fy|1046}}.

==History==
It is not known if Termylle was Melasune's daughter, niece or another female relative, but for the time she succeeded on the throne it was well established the rule that only [[Ishara Casalain]] direct female descendants can succeed.

Queen Ishara was in fact the founder of the kingdom of Andor.

Termylle ruled for eight years (FY 1046 - [[FY 1054|54]]) and was succeeded by [[Maragaine]].
